paite: Huan Mosi in adawng a, "Ahi na a, ngai in, ahon gingta kei ding ua, ka aw leng ana ngaikhe sam kei ding uh, 'Na kiang ah TOUPA akilak keí, achih ding ziak un,” achi hi.
heading: Pathian In Thillamdang Hihtheihna Mosi Apia
english: Moses answered, “But, behold, they will not believe me, nor listen to my voice; for they will say, ‘Yahweh has not appeared to you.’”

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, “Na khut a bang ahia?" achi a; ama'n, “Chiangkhun," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to him, “What is that in your hand?” He said, “A rod.”

paite: Ama'n, "Leitual ah khia in," achi a; leitual ah akhia a, gul ahong suak a; huai a pan Mosi ataikheta hi.
english: He said, “Throw it on the ground.” He threw it on the ground, and it became a snake; and Moses ran away from it.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, “Na khut zankhia inla, amei ah man in,” achi hi. Akhut azankhia a, amei ah amanta a, akhut ah chiangkhun ahong suak nawn hi;
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “Stretch out your hand, and take it by the tail.” He stretched out his hand, and took hold of it, and it became a rod in his hand.

paite: "huchi a apipute uh TOUPA Pathian, Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian leh Jakob' Pathian, na kiang ah akilak chih agintakna ding un,” achi hi.
english: “This is so that they may believe that Yahweh, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob, has appeared to you.”

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Tu in na ang ah na khut koih in," achi nawn hi. A-ang a akhut koih a, azankhiaktak in, ngai in, vuk bang in akhut aphakta hi.
english: Yahweh said furthermore to him, “Now put your hand inside your cloak.” He put his hand inside his cloak, and when he took it out, behold, his hand was leprous, as white as snow.

paite: "Ama'n na ang ah na khut koih nawn in," achi hi. A-ang ah akhut a akoih nawn a, huan alakkhiakleh, ngai in, akhut khat lam bang ahong suak nawn hi.
english: He said, “Put your hand inside your cloak again.” He put his hand inside his cloak again, and when he took it out of his cloak, behold, it had turned again as his other flesh.

paite: "Huan hichi ahi ding a, ahon gintak louh ua, chiamtehna khatna leng angaihkhiak kei uleh, chiamtehna nanung agintak ding uh ahi ding hi.
english: “It will happen, if they will not believe you or listen to the voice of the first sign, that they will believe the voice of the latter sign.

paite: Hichi ahong hi ding a, hiai chiamtehna nihte agintak louh lai ua, na aw leng angaihkhiak kei uleh, lui a pan tui na la dia, gamkeu ah na sung ding. Lui a pan na tui lakkhiak gamkeu ah sisan ahong suak ding hi,” achi hi.
english: It will happen, if they will not believe even these two signs or listen to your voice, that you shall take of the water of the river, and pour it on the dry land. The water which you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land.”

paite: Mosi in TOUPA kiang ah, "Aw Toupa, midangnal ka hi kei a, chik lai mah in, na sikha kiang a thu na gen nungsang in leng midang-awk leh pau zekai ka hi zaw hi,” achi hi.
english: Moses said to Yahweh, “O Lord, I am not eloquent, neither before now, nor since you have spoken to your servant; for I am slow of speech, and of a slow tongue.”

paite: TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Mihing kam bawl kua ahia? Ahihkeileh pau theiloute, nangongte, muhnate leh mittawte kua bawl ahia? Kei TOUPA'N ka bawl ahi kei maw?
english: Yahweh said to him, “Who made man’s mouth? Or who makes one mute, or deaf, or seeing, or blind? Isn’t it I, Yahweh?

paite: Huaiziak in tu in kuan inla, na kam ka ompih dia, na gen ding ka hon hilh ding," achi hi.
english: Now therefore go, and I will be with your mouth, and teach you what you shall speak.”

paite: Ama'n, "Aw TOUPA, hehpih in midang sawl in, na sawl dingpa khut in, ka hon ngen hi," achi hi.
english: Moses said, “Oh, Lord, please send someone else.”

paite: Mosi tung ah TOUPA hehna asouta a, "Aaron, na unaupa a-om kei maw? Ama'n hoihtak in thu agen thei, chih ka thei. Huan ngai in, nang kimuhpih ding in ahong paikhia a, ahon muh chiang in alungtang akipak ding hi.
english: Yahweh’s anger burned against Moses, and he said, “What about Aaron, your brother, the Levite? I know that he can speak well. Also, behold, he is coming out to meet you. When he sees you, he will be glad in his heart.

paite: Akiang ah thu na gen dia, akam ah thute na guang ding. Na kam ka ompih dia, na hih ding ka hon hilh ding hi.
english: You shall speak to him, and put the words in his mouth. I will be with your mouth, and with his mouth, and will teach you what you shall do.

paite: Amah mite kiang ah na thugenpa ahi dia; amah nang a ding in na kam' tang ahi dia, huan nang amah a ding in Pathian' tang na hi ding hi.
english: He will be your spokesman to the people. It will happen that he will be to you a mouth, and you will be to him as God.

paite: Chiamtehnate na hihna ding in, na khut in hiai chiangkhun na tawi ding ahi," achi hi.
english: You shall take this rod in your hand, with which you shall do the signs.”

paite: Mosi akisa a, asunghpa Jethro kiang ah akik a, akiang ah, "K'on ngen ahi, hon paisak inla, Aigupta gam a om ka unaute kiang ah ka kik dia, adam lai uhiam chih ka va kan ding," achi hi. Jethro in Mosi kiang ah, "Damtak in va hoh in," achi hi.
heading: Mosi Aigupta Ah Akik nawn
english: Moses went and returned to Jethro his father-in-law, and said to him, “Please let me go and return to my brothers who are in Egypt, and see whether they are still alive.” Jethro said to Moses, “Go in peace.”

paite: TOUPA'N Midian gam a Mosi kiang ah, "Pai inla, Aigupta gam ah kik nawn in. Thah hon tum mi teng lah asita ngal ua,” achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses in Midian, “Go, return into Egypt; for all the men who sought your life are dead.”

paite: Mosi in azi leh atapate api a, sabiltung tung ah atuangsak a, Aigupta gam ah akik nawnta hi. Mosi in akhut in Pathian' chiangkhun atawi hi.
english: Moses took his wife and his sons, and set them on a donkey, and he returned to the land of Egypt. Moses took God’s rod in his hand.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aigupta gam a kik nawn dia na kuan chiang in, na khut a ka koih huai thillamdangte tengteng Pharaoh ma ah hih ngeingei in. Himahleh alungtang ka khauhsak dia, huchi in mite apaisak kei ding," achi hi.
english: Yahweh said to Moses, “When you go back into Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have put in your hand, but I will harden his heart and he will not let the people go.

paite: Pharaoh kiang ah, "TOUPA'N Israel ka tapa ahi, ka ta masapen," achi hi.
english: You shall tell Pharaoh, ‘Yahweh says, Israel is my son, my firstborn,

paite: "K'on chi ahi, nna ahon sepsak theihna ding in, ka tapa paisak in. Paisak na nialleh, ngai in, na tapa ka that ding, na ta masapen ngei, na chi ding hi."
english: and I have said to you, “Let my son go, that he may serve me;” and you have refused to let him go. Behold, I will kill your firstborn son.’”

paite: Lampi a khualbuk ah hichi ahong hi a, TOUPA'N amah ana tuak a, thah ding in azongta hi.
english: On the way at a lodging place, Yahweh met Moses and wanted to kill him.

paite: Huchih lai in Zipporah in suang hiamtak khat ala a, atapa zekmuk vun a-atkhia a, akhebul ah akhia a, "Kei a ding in sikai pasal na hi taktak hi," achi hi.
english: Then Zipporah took a flint, and cut off the foreskin of her son, and cast it at his feet; and she said, “Surely you are a bridegroom of blood to me.”

paite: Huchi in amah apaisak hi. Zekvun ziak in, "Sisan kai pasal na hi," achi hi.
english: So he let him alone. Then she said, “You are a bridegroom of blood,” because of the circumcision.

paite: TOUPA'N Aaron kiang ah, "Mosi tuak ding in gamdai ah hoh in," achi hi. Ava hoh a, Pathian tang ah amah atuak a, atawp hi.
english: Yahweh said to Aaron, “Go into the wilderness to meet Moses.” He went, and met him on God’s mountain, and kissed him.

paite: Mosi in amah sawl TOUPA thu tengteng leh amah apiak chiamtehna tengteng toh Aaron ahilh hi.
english: Moses told Aaron all Yahweh’s words with which he had sent him, and all the signs with which he had instructed him.

paite: Mosi leh Aaron apaita ua; Israel suan upate tengteng akaikhawm vek uhi.
english: Moses and Aaron went and gathered together all the elders of the children of Israel.

paite: Mosi kiang a TOUPA'N thu agen tengteng leh mite mitmuh a chiamtehna ahih tengteng Aaron in agenta hi.
english: Aaron spoke all the words which Yahweh had spoken to Moses, and did the signs in the sight of the people.

paite: Huchi in mite'n agingta ua; TOUPA'N Israel suante ahong veh a, agimna uh amuta, chih azaktak un, alu uh kunsak in abeta uhi.
english: The people believed, and when they heard that Yahweh had visited the children of Israel, and that he had seen their affliction, then they bowed their heads and worshiped.
